marks.gloss_en: the mishna: one may not light with burning oil on a Festival
קשיא הילכתא אהילכתא: you said the halakha follows RYBL, and we hold the halakha follows Rava -- whose prayer leader at a Festival-Shabbat arvit need not mention the Festival
וקיימא לן הלכתא כרבא -- we hold the halakha follows Rava

Rava: when a Festival falls on Shabbat, the prayer leader who descends before the ark at arvit need not mention the Festival, for were it not Shabbat the prayer leader would not descend at arvit on a Festival
הכי השתא? there, by right even on Shabbat he need not descend -- the Rabbis instituted it because of danger; but here, it is the day that is obligated in four prayers (= p_takana_sakana, p_rybl_taam)
there [the prayer leader's arvit], by right even on Shabbat he need not [descend]; it is the Rabbis who instituted it, because of danger
ולית הלכתא ככל הני שמעתתא, אלא כי הא דאמר רבי יהושע בן לוי -- the halakha follows none of these teachings but RYBL's
the halakha [on mentioning Hanukkah in the additional prayer] follows these teachings (the stam: ולית הלכתא -- it does NOT follow any of them)
the Sages' position is the same as the first tanna's
מאי טעמא? לפי שאין שורפין קדשים ביום טוב
מנהני מילי? אמר חזקיה, וכן תנא דבי חזקיה: עד בקר ... בקר שני לשריפתו
what is the reason [one may not light with burning-oil on a Festival]? because one does not burn consecrated things on a Festival
אביי אמר: עולת שבת בשבתו -- ולא עולת חול ביום טוב
Abaye: the source is 'the olah of Shabbat on its Shabbat' (Num 28:10)
רבא אמר: הוא לבדו יעשה לכם
Rava: the source is 'that alone may be done for you' (Ex 12:16)
רב אשי אמר: שבתון -- עשה; ואין עשה דוחה את לא תעשה ועשה
